_README: The pairs the wizard offers, and the server it fills in by default.
DATA, so a new instrument or a new liquidity provider is an edit to
this file - not a code change and not a release to every PC.
SYMBOLS MUST BE SPELLED EXACTLY AS THE TERMINAL SPELLS THEM, and
that spelling belongs to the LIQUIDITY PROVIDER, not to us. The
same gold is XAUUSD.f on one LP and XAUUSD_ or GOLD on the next.
When the LP changes, this file changes. Check the spelling in
MetaTrader 5's Market Watch, or with the Find symbols button on the
Exchanges page.
{contract} is the month-and-year code the trader types at setup -
Z6, U6, V6, 1226 - and it too is the LP's spelling. Put it in
either leg, both, or neither. A leg without it asks nothing.
pair_type decides whether the spread has a fair value:
SPOT_FUTURE    spot against its own future - a basis
FUTURE_FUTURE  two contract months of one instrument
RELATED        two different instruments - NO fair value
Not cosmetic. A basis marked RELATED loses the fair value the
strategy trades; two different instruments marked as a basis are
given one they do not have.
For a monthly roll, do NOT edit this file - it only seeds a first
install. Use deploy/pairs.json with ADD-PAIRS.bat, which puts the
new contracts onto machines that are already set up.
